comment: Owned by the license review. One row per file of ghostty-next/src/shell-integration at the gitlink: the cmux-next app bundles the directory (scripts/cmux-next/bundle-ghostty-resources.sh -> Contents/Resources/ghostty/shell-integration) and cmux-tui embeds the rows with embedded=true (include_str! in cmux-tui-core/src/shell_integration.rs, every target). marker is a regex the file must match (it pins the reviewed upstream version or origin). text: a key of texts, 'ghostty' (Ghostty's MIT LICENSE, already in every notice) or 'cmux-gpl' (the GPL-3.0 text every cmux package ships as LICENSE). shell_integration_notices.py fails a file without a row, a stale row, a marker or text mismatch, an embedded flag that differs from the include_str! set, and an include from another Ghostty tree.

bash-preexec-0.7.0.source: LICENSE.md at tag 0.7.0 (commit d866eeefdb8dfce075cbd4e37dc73c4deb4b0bd2) of https://github.com/rcaloras/bash-preexec; ghostty-next 5d6615fc4 'bash: upgrade to bash-preexec 0.7.0'
